## 🚨 Incident Alert Enricher

**What this workflow does:**
Receives a webhook alert (from PagerDuty, Grafana, Prometheus, or any monitoring tool), enriches it with AI analysis, and posts a structured incident summary to Slack.

**Setup steps:**
1. Configure the Webhook node URL in your monitoring tool
2. Add your Claude API key in Credentials → Add New → Header Auth
   - Name: `x-api-key`, Value: `your-claude-api-key`
   - OR use OpenRouter: Header Auth, Name: `Authorization`, Value: `Bearer your-openrouter-key`
3. Add Slack Webhook URL in the Slack node credentials
4. Set `SLACK_CHANNEL` in the Set node to your target channel

**Credential setup:**
- Claude API: https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys
- OpenRouter (alternative): https://openrouter.ai/keys
- Slack Webhook: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks

## 🔧 AI Node — Credential Setup

**Option A: Claude API (Anthropic)**
- Go to Credentials → New → HTTP Header Auth
- Name: `Claude API Key`
- Header Name: `x-api-key`
- Header Value: `sk-ant-api...` (from console.anthropic.com)

**Option B: OpenRouter (cheaper, 100+ models)**
- Go to Credentials → New → HTTP Header Auth
- Name: `OpenRouter API Key`
- Header Name: `Authorization`
- Header Value: `Bearer sk-or-v1-...`
- Change URL to: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
- Change model to: `anthropic/claude-opus-4-6`
